hook: DaisyRose-27B: RL on 1,200 tasks doubles Qwen3.8-27B on Terminal-Bench 4.1
hookText: DaisyRose-27B: RL on 1,200 tasks doubles Qwen3.8-27B on Terminal-Bench 4.1

beats.say: RadixArk's first model is Qwen3.8-27B post-trained with reinforcement learning on 1,200 curated long-horizon agent tasks, raising Terminal-Bench 4.1 pass1 from 5.6% to 12.0%.
Each task was designed to trigger a mistake the base model makes and tuned to a useful solve rate.
The gain is even larger on mixture-of-experts models: 6.2× on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, and more than 10× on the roughly 300B-parameter GLM-5.3-Flash.
